title: Brihat Jataka
author: Varahamihira
_scan_note: This book is scanned two pages to a sheet: 115 PDF sheets = 230 book pages. It is the only book in the corpus with this layout. The split is a rendering concern only -- page identity is the dense sequence p0001..p0230.
_verse_note: In this book Sanskrit appears ONLY as set-off verses and colophons -- verified across all 219 content pages -- so a bare 'line contains Devanagari' test is safe here and is what the corpus was verified against. It is NOT the default: profiles/DEFAULTS sets verse_requires_danda true, because in BPHS and Jataka Parijata Devanagari terms appear inline in English prose, where that test would shred paragraphs.
_chapter_note: The printed chapter title ends '...अध्यायः'. The character class tolerates Surya's ध->घ and ध->व misreads of the conjunct, and the visarga appearing as ASCII colon.
